    10→    fun merge(before: ChangedData<T>?, after: ChangedData<T>): ChangedData<T>? =

**File:** `/Users/admin/project/integrated-search/inbound-adapter/handler/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/inbound_adapter/handler/listener/ProductDynamicIndexListener.kt`

```kotlin
@Service
class ProductIndexApplicationService(
    private val productIndexRepository: ProductIndexRepository,
    private val productAssembleService: ProductAssembleService,
) {
    fun indexProducts(changedData: List<ChangedData<ChangedProductDocument>>): IndexResult {
        val indexDocuments =
            changedData
                .let(ProductMergeStrategy::merge)           // Deduplicate & merge by ID
                .let { productAssembleService.assemble(it) } // Fetch categories/brands/malls
                .filter(ProductEvaluator::evaluate)         // Filter indexable documents
        
        return productIndexRepository.bulk(indexDocuments)
    }
}
```

**Flow:**
1. **ProductMergeStrategy.merge()**: Deduplicates by product ID, merges by offset, determines which dependencies to fetch
2. **ProductAssembleService.assemble()**: Fetches Category/Brand/Manufacturer/Mall from proxy APIs, maps to IndexDocument<ProductDocument>
3. **ProductEvaluator.evaluate()**: Filters documents (currently returns true for all)
4. **ProductIndexRepository.bulk()**: Bulk indexes to Elasticsearch
